question: Hong Kong market for the overseas exam of the frozen 3W (3w-1.9): every common stock EODHD lists for HK, listed today or delisted, downloaded once and kept if it met an HK version of the research pool (unadjusted close >= HK$1, >= HK$78M traded, about US$10M) on enough sessions in 2005-01..2025-06. Engineering check: lists and counts only, no returns.
next_step: The kept list becomes the frozen dataset hk-a-1995-v1 (data-hk-a-v1); the frozen 3W 1.9 is then examined once on it against same-day random HK stocks.
notes: HK floors are the US pool translated, fixed before any HK data is seen: HK$1 avoids penny stocks (the US $5 floor's purpose); HK$78M per day is about US$10M at 7.8 HKD/USD.
No primary-exchange filter: the provider's HK list is one exchange. Tickers in both the listed and delisted lists are left out (reused codes).
Passed if errors after the retry are at most 2% of candidates and at least 300 stocks are kept; empty histories are reported separately.
